concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-platforms-reconciliation-use-cases-reconcile-transfers]] — 2026-09-15 Platforms transfer/payout accounting-report guide for internal versus bank event types, Transfer/Transaction IDs, booked signed legs, references and Statement alternative; no bank-receipt proof.
warnings: Transfer Id alone is not booking; booked status plus populated Transaction Id is the guide's balance/payment-instrument booking signal.

The report's worked two-account example has distinct leg Transfer IDs and a shared booked Transaction ID, but the related internal-transfer webhook guide shows distinct booked transactionIds on outgoing and incoming example legs. Do not assume a universal cross-leg Transaction Id join; correlate actual account, direction/counterparty, transfer and reference evidence.
A bankTransfer or Statement report row does not independently prove beneficiary-bank receipt.
